scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide-angle view of a city street with tall buildings and trees lining both sides of the road. The sun shines brightly overhead, casting long shadows across the asphalt. A car drives down the road, while pedestrians walk along the sidewalk. The street is lined with tall buildings, some of which have balconies and windows. Trees line the street, providing shade and adding to the urban landscape. The sky is clear and blue, with only a few wispy clouds visible.
